mainEntity.name: How much does a Jaguar XK 5.0 engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A fully rebuilt Jaguar XK 5.0 engine typically costs between £8,000 and £12,000 for supply only, while reconditioned units start from £5,500. Used verified donor units are available from £3,000. Rebuilt 508PN units include upgraded oil pump drives and 12-month warranty. Supply and fit adds £910-£1,170 depending on specialist workshop location. Main dealer quotes frequently exceed £14,000, making specialist replacement highly cost-effective.

mainEntity.name: What are the common signs my Jaguar XK 5.0 engine is failing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Early warning signs of Jaguar XK 5.0 engine failure include sudden oil pressure warnings, excessive oil consumption (over 1L per 1,000 miles), and metallic knocking from the bottom end. Oil pressure warning lights indicate potential oil pump drive failure. Blue smoke from the exhaust suggests valve stem seal degradation or bore scoring. Persistent metallic knocking means bottom end bearing failure - stop driving immediately.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine on a Jaguar XK 5.0?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, replacing the engine is typically worthwhile given the car's retained value. A rebuilt unit costs £8,000-£12,000 versus £14,000+ dealer quotes, preserving a grand tourer worth £8,000-£18,000. XK 5.0 values remain strong; well-maintained examples retain significant worth post-repair. Specialist rebuilt engines include upgraded components addressing original OEM failure points. Minimum 12-month unlimited mileage warranty provides financial protection post-replacement.

mainEntity.name: What is the Jaguar Recall JAG-19V-005 for the XK 5.0?

acceptedAnswer.text: Jaguar issued Recall JAG-19V-005 to address oil pump drive sleeve fractures in Gen III 5.0L AJ-V8 engines. The original sleeve could break, causing immediate oil pressure loss and engine seizure. The recall replaces the oil pump assembly with a revised, stronger drive sleeve. If your XK 5.0 has no record of this recall being performed, preventative replacement is highly recommended. Preventative replacement costs £900-£1,400 at a specialist, which is cheap insurance against a £10,000+ engine failure.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Jaguar XK 5.0 engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A complete Jaguar XK 5.0 engine replacement typically requires 3-5 working days for specialist supply & fit, including removal, calibration, coolant bleed, and road testing. Complex aluminium architecture extends labour time versus mainstream models. ECU adaptation requires Jaguar-specific diagnostic equipment post-fit. Nationwide specialist network enables local fitting without main dealer appointment delays.

commonProblems.h2: Jaguar XK 5.0 Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The Jaguar XK 5.0 relies on the Gen III 5.0L AJ-V8, which delivers effortless grand touring performance but carries well-documented vulnerabilities around the oil pump drive and cylinder bore integrity. When these issues progress beyond early warnings, the risk of catastrophic internal damage rises sharply, making specialist intervention essential. Every rebuilt engine supplied through EnginesMarket includes upgraded internal components designed to permanently address the original failure point, backed by a minimum 12-month unlimited mileage warranty.

problems.h4: Oil Pump Drive Failure - Why the Jaguar XK 5.0 508PN Seizes Prematurely
problems.rootCause: The oil pump drive sleeve connecting the crankshaft to the pump rotor can fracture due to inadequate material strength and harmonics. This causes oil pressure to drop to zero without warning, leading to rapid engine seizure. Jaguar issued Recall JAG-19V-005 to address this, but many vehicles never received the updated part.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replacement of the oil pump assembly with the revised JAG-19V-005 spec unit, new drive sleeve, and sump gasket.
repairOptions.longevity: Permanent fix with revised component. Only viable if the engine has NO oil pressure warning and NO knocking.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit of a rebuilt engine with the revised oil pump drive, new timing components, fully tested, with 12-month warranty.
repairOptions.longevity: The only reliable option if the engine has seized or thrown a rod.

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical Jaguar XK 5.0 holds a UK market value of approximately £8,000-£18,000 [THIRD-PARTY]. A specialist rebuilt engine (£8,000-£12,000) represents a significant but viable investment to preserve the car's grand touring capability, especially compared to the depreciation hit of scrapping a well-maintained example.
problems.recommendation: If your Jaguar XK 5.0 has no record of Recall JAG-19V-005 being performed, spend the £900-£1,400 on preventative oil pump replacement at a specialist. It is the cheapest insurance you can buy for a Gen III AJ-V8. Once the pump fails and the engine seizes, replacement is your only reliable path.
problems.cta: -> Compare rebuilt 508PN Jaguar XK 5.0 engine prices with upgraded oil pump drive

problems.h4: Cylinder Bore Scoring - Why 5.0L Engines Burn Oil
problems.rootCause: Direct injection on the Gen III 5.0L AJ-V8 leaves intake valves without fuel washing, allowing carbon buildup. More critically, cylinder walls can develop vertical scoring marks, usually on cylinders 4, 5, and 8. Oil consumption climbs to 1L per 1,000 miles or worse, with piston ring collapse and poor cylinder liner material suspected as contributors.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Walnut blasting of intake valves, compression test, and oil consumption measurement over 1,000 miles.
repairOptions.longevity: Confirms diagnosis only. Does not fix bore scoring. Use before committing to replacement.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit of a rebuilt engine with cylinder liners verified or replaced, new piston rings, upgraded oil pump, bench tested.
repairOptions.longevity: 100k+ miles. Includes 12-month warranty. More reliable than a rebuild of your scored block.

problems.vehicleValueCheck: Given the £8,000+ value of the XK 5.0, investing in a comprehensive engine replacement is essential preventative maintenance. If oil consumption exceeds 1L per 1,000 miles, replacement is usually better value than attempting to rebore an existing scored block.
problems.recommendation: Bore scoring is progressive and will not improve. If oil consumption is under 1L per 1,000 miles, monitor it closely. Once it exceeds that threshold, replacement with a warranted, fully inspected rebuilt unit is the safest long-term investment for your Jaguar XK 5.0.
